Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL333. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to enforce SMILES presence. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL333 and standard_type IC50. Keep only rows where pubmed_id or doi is not null. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
